name: System tray
description: StatusNotifierItem icons from running applications, with the rest behind a chevron.

pinned.label: On the panel
pinned.description: StatusNotifierItem ids shown on the panel, in this order. Empty shows every item; pin any and the rest move behind the chevron. Settings has a page that edits this by dragging, which is easier than typing ids.

hidden.label: Never shown
hidden.description: Ids left out altogether, not even behind the chevron.
